description:
Numerology, Human Design, Yi-King, Archangels: know yourself better.
Empreinte de l'Ame is a self-knowledge app bringing together several complementary approaches, to explore who you are at your own pace — no notifications, no pressure.

🔮 NUMEROLOGY
• Destiny: Life Path, Shadow, 4 Summits, Personal Year
• Portrait: Soul Grid, Pythagorean Arrows
• Identity: Expression Number, Soul Urge, Bridge Number
• Predictions: Personal Year, Month and Day, Quarters

☯ YI-KING
Traditional three-coin cast, 64 hexagrams, history of your readings.

👼 ARCHANGELS
Your Guardian Archangel based on your birth date, and a daily draw among 44 cards.

🕉 HUMAN DESIGN
Type, Strategy, Authority, Profile, and a visual Bodygraph chart — with personalized predictions (Gate of the Day, life cycles).

🕐 MIRROR HOURS
50 mirror hours, double, reversed and triple, with their guardian angel and meaning.

💞 COMPATIBILITY
Compare two profiles (numerology and Human Design) and share the result as a PDF.

📈 BIORHYTHMS
Your physical, emotional and intellectual cycles on a chart you can scroll with your finger.

🪞 MIRROR OF THE SOUL
A question and an energy for the day based on your Life Path.

🧘 MEDITATION
Timer with ambient sound for a moment of calm.

✨ AND MORE
• Up to 3 profiles (you, your loved ones)
• Bilingual French/English
• Works offline, no data sent anywhere
• Completely free

An app designed to slow you down, not to capture your attention.
